subject: Staged evidence handoff & routing fallback for UK Addendum (TIA)
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@medixcare.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: MedixCare Legal <legal@medixcare.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: UK Addendum — phased evidence handoff and fallback routing

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Legal asked me to follow up with a concrete ask so we can close the UK Addendum / TIA scoping on our side. High level: we need a phased evidence delivery (index of artifacts + verifier extracts) and a written fallback routing plan if the onshore path is unavailable during pilot.

Specifically can you provide: 
- an index of artifacts you can deliver in week 1 (e.g., export maps, subprocessors list, pseudonymization docs)
- a short binary statement on whether Redwood can route all UK-origin traffic to an EU-only processing path as a stop-gap (including any subprocessor changes required)
- copies or extracts of the relevant SCCs/IDTA clauses you rely on for the fallback routing assertion

We can accept a phased delivery (week 1: index + extracts; week 2: full export). Procurement is targeting a Nov 30 signature if we can get the core artifacts earlier. I attached an evidence index template (medix_evidence_index.xlsx) and a list of our minimal acceptance checks.

Appreciate a quick runbook we can share with our legal/procurement teams.

Best,
Sofia Ramos
Data Protection Officer
MedixCare

Attachment: medix_evidence_index.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@medixcare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: UK Addendum — phased evidence handoff and fallback routing

Sofia — thanks for the clear ask. Below is what we can commit to for a staged handoff and the fallback routing constraints.

Week 1 (by Wed Nov 24):
- Artifact index (spreadsheet): list of files + short description (I will upload a first draft).
- Subprocessor snapshot (UTC timestamped CSV) and primary access control attestations.
- Extracts from our SCCs that reference routing and subcontractor commitments (PDF extracts).

Week 2 (by Wed Dec 1):
- Full transfer map (redwood_transfer_map_v1.pdf) showing routes for UK-origin requests, including primary EU path and historic onshore hops.
- Redacted sample logs showing geo-routing decisions (sample only).

Fallback routing statement (short):
- Redwood can operate a temporary EU-only processing path for UK-origin transactions for the pilot window, provided MedixCare accepts that:
  1) some optional subsystems (real-time analytics) will be served by a US vendor fallback unless a short-term EU replica is provisioned, and
  2) we will need subprocessor notifications to be updated for the replica (2–3 days of lead time).

We will attach SCC/IDTA extracts that we rely on (see attached sccs-uk-idta-extract.pdf). If you need a contractual amendment to lock-in the fallback routing as a guarantee, we should surface that to your legal team now — otherwise we will commit operationally for the pilot window but prefer to avoid hard SLA-level guarantees until capacity is reserved.

Uploading first artifacts to the Drive link you shared and attaching the transfer map draft. Laura — please confirm procurement notes re: signature timing and whether we should provide a written fallback addendum for procurement. Marissa — I cc'd you for the customer commercial view.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Trust & Safety, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_transfer_map_v1.pdf, sccs-uk-idta-extract.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: UK Addendum — phased evidence handoff and fallback routing

Quick commercial note: if MedixCare wants a contractual fallback (routing guarantee), that would typically sit in a DPA addendum and may require a short-term capacity reservation (Dedicated or burst plan) — we can price an ops-backed addendum that covers the pilot window. Happy to share a ballpark once legal confirms scope.

Marissa
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@medixcare.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: MedixCare Legal <legal@medixcare.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:41:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: UK Addendum — phased evidence handoff and fallback routing

Markus — thanks, the schedule looks good. A couple of clarifications from legal:
- We need the subprocessor snapshot to include data residency regions (UK/EU/US) per subprocessor so we can confirm no hidden US routing.
- For the fallback statement, legal prefers a written option (not a hard SLA) that obligates Redwood to pursue an EU-only path first and provide weekly status updates if fallbacks require US hops. That should be enough for procurement to accept the pilot.

Procurement can accept the week 1 partial artifacts for an initial signature if we get the index + subprocessor residency CSV and the fallback option statement by EOD Nov 24. Can you confirm? Also — can we do a brief canary the week of Nov 29 to validate routing in a lower-throughput window?

Sofia
DPO, MedixCare

Attachment: medix_acceptance_checks.pdf (referenced in index)

Team — forwarding the thread and summarizing action items for our side. Internal only: do not share this section with the customer in raw form.

Summary / commitments: 
1) Deliverables by EOD Nov 24 (week 1):
   - Artifact index (I will upload to the Drive folder).
   - Subprocessor snapshot CSV (include residency column: uk/eu/us).
   - Fallback option statement (ops-backed, weekly status updates).
2) Week of Nov 29: run a low-volume canary for UK-origin traffic to exercise the EU-only path; coordinate with infra and the on-call SRE. 
3) Week 2 (by Dec 1): full transfer map and redacted samples.

Risks / internal notes: 
- If MedixCare requires a binding routing guarantee we need a short procurement thread to price Dedicated burst capacity for the pilot. Marissa — please prepare a quote matrix (Dedicated burst vs. operational commitment) and notify contracts if we need an addendum template.
- Vivek — prep a quick subprocessor residency export and highlight any subcontractors that currently have US-only deployments. I can redact vendor-specific IP before sharing with MedixCare.

Next actions: Markus to upload index + sps CSV draft by Nov 24; Marissa to prepare a pricing sketch if addendum requested; Laura to confirm procurement timeline & acceptance criteria.
